item.title: In Canada: bbno$ Found Sanctuary Online. Now, He Wants to Pay It Forward to Others
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's music update. We're shining the spotlight on one of the most unique artists trending on Billboard right now: bbno$.
[Short music transition]
Host: With over a billion Spotify streams and back-to-back Juno Fan Choice Awards, bbno$ is taking the music industry by storm. But who is the person behind this viral rapper, singer, and songwriter? Born Alex Gumuchian, this 30-year-old Vancouver native is on a mission to figure out the man behind the music.
[Short clip of bbno$'s music plays]
Host: bbno$ is currently on his Internet Explorer Tour, supporting his self-titled 2025 album that hit No. 33 on the Billboard Canadian Albums chart. His shows are a high-energy, unpredictable experience filled with memes, costumes, and props – a space for fans to be their weirdest selves and bond over shared interests.
[Short music transition]
Host: For Alex, the internet has been a source of community since he was a homeschooled child. He found friendship and connection online, and now he's creating a sanctuary for himself and his fans to express themselves freely. With his music and live shows, bbno$ is breaking the mold and reaching fans in a way that traditional record labels can't.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. If you want to learn more about bbno$ and his journey, check out the full story on Billboard Canada. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next update.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
